glossary.definition: The maximum number of tokens a model can consider in one request, including the prompt and its output.
Choosing and arranging the tokens a model sees at each step: instructions, memories, history and tool results.
The drop in accuracy as input length grows, even when the task itself stays simple.
The finding that models use information at the start or end of a long input better than information in the middle.
The input length at which a model still performs well on your task, often far below the advertised maximum.
Summarizing older parts of a conversation into a shorter block so the session can continue within the window.
Removing old tool outputs from the context while keeping the record that the call happened.
A component that saves an agent’s thread state by session ID so it can resume later.
Durable facts about users or entities kept outside the model and retrieved when relevant.
Records of specific past runs or experiences, retrieved when a similar situation comes up.
Condensing several episodes into a short, higher-level lesson that cites them.
A key prefix, such as tenant and user ID, that scopes where memories are written and searched.
Time to live: how long an item is kept before it expires automatically.
India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, which includes duties to erase personal data on request or when its purpose ends.
Using sequences such as ../ to reach files outside an allowed directory.
A graph of entities and relationships where each relationship carries the time it was valid.
Marking a relationship as no longer true by setting its end date, instead of deleting it.

symptomRouter.symptom: Answers get worse late in long sessions or with long inputs
symptomRouter.advice: Curate the window: fewer, higher-signal chunks, key facts at the start and the question last.

symptomRouter.symptom: The agent hits the context limit or loses the thread mid-task
symptomRouter.advice: Clear stale tool results and compact old turns, keeping IDs, amounts and open tasks.

symptomRouter.symptom: It forgets the user between sessions
symptomRouter.advice: Extract and reconcile durable facts per user, and retrieve the relevant few each turn.
Log episodes, retrieve by recency, importance and relevance, and inject short lessons.

symptomRouter.symptom: It remembers stale, sensitive or deleted things
symptomRouter.advice: Allow-list what is saved, invalidate old facts, and delete every copy on request.

symptomRouter.symptom: We want the agent to manage its own notes
symptomRouter.advice: Give it a memory tool with safe path handling and pair it with context editing.

symptomRouter.symptom: The agent repeats the same multi-step routine
symptomRouter.advice: Save proven workflows as procedures or skills, retrieve them by task, and retire them when they go stale.

symptomRouter.symptom: Memory returns old nominees and addresses, and cannot chain facts
symptomRouter.advice: Store entities and dated relationships, close old edges, and traverse the graph for the current time.
